description: Portrait white canvas. Upper: rectangular blackboard outline with stick pitcher (left, cap, arm extended), blurred grey speeding ball with streak (middle), stick batter (right, helmet, bat), eraser/chalk tray. Lower: large stick lecturer holding a sheet of paper, hand on hip. No text on board yet.
Text typed onto blackboard between pitcher and batter: '0.' then '0.9c' with '(604,000,' then '(604,000,000 mph)' below it; character-by-character reveal across the activity frames. Figures static.
Same blackboard scene with completed text '0.9c' and '(604,000,000 mph)' under the blurred ball; lecturer below unchanged.
Hard cut (single frame) to close-up of the lecturer, large head and paper, with a thought cloud above containing the blurred speeding ball. Blackboard gone.
Lecturer close-up with paper (lower) and thought-cloud containing blurred streaking ball (upper). No text.

Hard cut to close-up of stick pitcher with black cap and glove (left) releasing a small crisp baseball with speed lines (right). Text NORMAL PHYSICS (top), '~0c' and '(80 mph)' with down arrow to the ball.
Pitcher close-up: NORMAL PHYSICS heading, '~0c (80 mph)' with arrow pointing to the baseball.

Whole canvas slides horizontally: the white NORMAL PHYSICS panel exits left while a black panel headed PARANORMAL PHYSICS enters from right (white line-art wizard with staff, row of clock-faced balls with sparkles). Hard edge between panels.

Black panel, white line art: heading PARANORMAL PHYSICS (top); row of glowing balls with clock faces, speed lines and sparkles (middle); bearded wizard in hat with sparkling staff (lower, cropped at bottom).

Horizontal slide back: black PARANORMAL panel exits left; white NORMAL PHYSICS panel returns from right, now reading '0.9 c (604,000,000 mph)' with curved arrow toward a blurred streaking ball. Panel edge visible mid-move.
White panel: NORMAL PHYSICS; '0.9 c' and '(604,000,000 mph)'; curved arrow down to blurred grey ball with long speed streak (left).

Hard cut to new composition: crisp baseball with horizontal speed lines at left-centre; at upper-left a tipped grey cup/tube with grey blurred spill, upper-right a tipped bag with grey blurred crumbs; small grey blurred specks lower. No text.
Ball with speed lines (centre-left); grey blurred cup (upper-left) and bag (upper-right) with blurred particles and two lower specks.
Cup, bag and particles change from grey blurred rendering to crisp black line-art (cup upper-left spilling, bag upper-right with crumbs); ball unchanged. Single sample frame; exact onset UNRESOLVED.
Small crisp baseball with speed lines (left-centre); crisp line-art tipped cup (upper-left) and tipped bag with crumbs (upper-right); four tiny specks.
Hard cut to larger baseball (left-centre, speed lines) over a field of many grey blurred oval specks scattered across the whole canvas. Cup and bag gone.
Large baseball with speed lines at left; scattered grey blurred oval specks fill canvas.
Grey blurred ovals swap to crisp small black tadpole-like molecule marks across the canvas; baseball unchanged. Single frame; onset UNRESOLVED.
Baseball (left) with speed lines; field of small crisp black molecule marks. No text.
Label '~1,000 mph' with small curved arrow to a nearby molecule appears right of the ball (single frame).
Ball left; molecules; label '~1,000 mph' with arrow at right.
Second label '604,000,000 mph' with curved arrow pointing at the ball appears above '~1,000 mph' (single frame).
Ball with labels '604,000,000 mph' (arrow to ball) and '~1,000 mph' (arrow to molecule); molecules scattered.

Hard cut to two-panel stacked layout split by a horizontal line: top panel baseball with stippled debris/streamline trail; bottom panel baseball with 'PARTIAL VACUUM' and four outward arrows, stipple trail and tiny hatch marks at front.
Two stacked panels: top ball with stipple streamlines; bottom ball with label PARTIAL VACUUM and arrows behind it, hatch marks at front.
Handwritten label 'FUSION ZONE' with curved arrow to ball's front edge appears in bottom panel upper-right.
Two panels; bottom shows PARTIAL VACUUM and FUSION ZONE labels with arrows.
Fan of wavy black arrows (radiating rays) appears at right of bottom-panel ball, extending to panel edges (single frame).
Bottom panel: ball with fan of wavy arrows radiating right, PARTIAL VACUUM label left; top panel unchanged. FUSION ZONE label no longer visible in tile.

Hard cut to wide white scene: ground line, tiny stick pitcher with label DISINTEGRATING PITCHER (left), ball with trail (right) labelled BALL, nested grey arcs around, text 'T = 30 NANOSECONDS' lower right.
White wide scene: ground line, pitcher and ball, concentric arcs, labels DISINTEGRATING PITCHER and BALL, 'T = 30 NANOSECONDS'.

First frame (f982) is already a grey-background version of the scene: arcs filled grey with white glow dome, new label DEVELOPING FIREBALL with arrows. Then ~117 frames of continuous slide/zoom-out toward the right revealing 'UNSUSPECTING BATTER' at right edge, label PLASMIZED AIR appearing between f1075 and f1098, T label moving. Onset of PLASMIZED AIR UNRESOLVED.

Grey background scene: glowing grey fireball dome with arcs; labels PLASMIZED AIR, DEVELOPING FIREBALL, DISINTEGRATING PITCHER, BALL, UNSUSPECTING BATTER with tiny batter at right; 'T = 30 NANOSECONDS' below ground line.
Hard cut to white canvas: close baseball with stipple trail and a jagged starburst impact shape at its right with small tick marks.
Baseball with stipple trail and jagged starburst at right; no text.
Many thin curved lines with small end dots radiate outward from ball front (fragment trails) appear (single frame).
Ball, starburst, stipple, and radiating curved fragment trails with end dots.
Small crackly burst marks appear at the ends of the radiating trails (single frame).
Ball and starburst with radiating trails each ending in a small spiky burst.
Hard cut to grey wide scene: large glowing grey dome with nested arcs; faded labels DISINTEGRATING PITCHER, BALL, UNSUSPECTING BATTER with batter (right); text 'T = 60 NANOSECONDS'.
Grey scene: dome and arcs, ball with trail, batter at right labelled UNSUSPECTING BATTER, 'T = 60 NANOSECONDS'.

Label near batter changes: red 'DISINTEGRATING' with red strike through 'UNSUSPECTING'; T label changes to 'T = 63 NANOSECONDS'; batter drawn faded/scribbled. Scene shifted slightly right/dome larger vs previous hold (possible small camera shift, UNRESOLVED).
Grey dome scene; red 'DISINTEGRATING' with struck 'UNSUSPECTING BATTER' at right; ball and trail; 'T = 63 NANOSECONDS'.
Red wavy sine-line labelled '1c' appears horizontally from ball region toward batter (single frame).
Grey scene with red wavy line '1c' running to the ball/batter area; red DISINTEGRATING label; T = 63 NANOSECONDS; frame slightly shifted up versus G0043.
Hard cut to white canvas: three nested grey arcs with dense black dot cloud streaming leftwards from a dense point at right. No text.
White: nested grey arcs and stipple dot cloud, no labels, no figures.
Stick batter with bat, kneeling catcher with mask and mitt, home plate, and label 'UNSUSPECTING BATTER' with arrow appear at right (single frame).
Arcs and dot cloud at left; batter with bat and kneeling catcher at right; label UNSUSPECTING BATTER.

Dot cloud/starburst now reaches batter; label turns to red DISINTEGRATING with UNSUSPECTING struck, batter and catcher redrawn in altered poses with small scribbles; 'T = 63 NANOSECONDS' appears. Details small, MEDIUM.
Arcs and dense dots at left hitting batter; red DISINTEGRATING / struck UNSUSPECTING BATTER; catcher; 'T = 63 NANOSECONDS'.

Hard cut to wide white scene: large nested arcs rising from ground line; labels DISINTEGRATED PITCHER, DISINTEGRATED BATTER, DISINTEGRATED CATCHER, DISINTEGRATED REFEREE along ground, 'UNSUSPECTING BACKSTOP' with arrow at right; 'T = 75 NANOSECONDS'.
Wide white scene as described: ground line, arcs, four DISINTEGRATED labels, UNSUSPECTING BACKSTOP, 'T = 75 NANOSECONDS'. Text small; wording partly unreadable at tile scale.
Hard cut to hilltop landscape: house with chimney smoke and tall fir tree (left), tiny stick figure on hill, grey city skyline across grey slope. No text.
Hilltop: house, fir tree, small figure, grey skyline and slope on white sky.
Whole frame floods with bright white radial glow and light rays with grey vignette; tree casts a shadow; flash single sample.
Hilltop scene after flash: small cloud-like fireball on horizon over skyline; sky white.
Horizon fireball becomes larger and puffier with a glow on the slope (single frame).
Hilltop with larger puffy fireball cloud on horizon; glow on grey slope.
Over six frames fireball rises into a mushroom cloud with a stem, with faint translucent upper cap fading in; glow on slope.
Hilltop with line-art mushroom cloud on horizon, house, tree, figure.
Dashed curved shock-wave arcs appear around the mushroom cloud, on both sides (single frame).
Mushroom cloud with dashed arcs; shock arcs now closer to the house on left and more extended on right than at onset.
House roof and tree redrawn tilted/bent toward the left; small figure displaced; arcs unchanged (single frame).
Hilltop with damaged tilted house and bent tree, mushroom cloud, dashed arcs.
Hard cut to light grey street map (roads, river, blocks) with a small red location pin at centre.
Grey street map with red pin at centre; no other marks.
Dashed red circle centred on the pin appears (single frame); appears fully drawn, write-on onset UNRESOLVED.
Street map with red pin and large dashed red circle around it.
Hard cut to map zoomed/faded under a large black line-art billowing fireball cloud filling the canvas with white glow; red pin and circle gone.
Large black line-art puffy cloud with ragged edges over faded map, white centre.
Over six frames the black line-art cloud fades to grey and a dark grey radial crater with scattered grey blobs emerges at centre over the map.
Final frame held about 5 s: street map with grey crater-like dark radial centre and scattered grey debris; no text, no figures.
